title: A · Attention teaser for a learning module
lesson: Every slot is a decision you make: what we see first, how close, which light, who your presenter is, what they say. You brief, compare takes, choose.

frames.task: Design the presenter: two or three candidates from a short description, or a photo the designer brings. They pick.

slots.purpose: Opener: the first thing the viewer sees
slots.task: Decide what the viewer sees first. Brief it with the shot card, draft it twice on veo-fast changing ONE thing (light or distance), compare the two takes, choose, then render the final on veo.

slots.purpose: B-roll: the advisor prepares, no face
slots.task: Your first render. Show that the advisor prepares for the client, without a face. Brief it with three fields: what the viewer should take away, the one action, the sound.

slots.purpose: Conversation 1/2: she names the problem, in German
slots.task: Design your presenter: ask for two or three start-frame candidates (age, clothing, room) or bring a photo, and pick one. Write the German line yourself, 14 words at most. Render, then fix one thing.

slots.purpose: Conversation 2/2: his punchline, then a look into the lens

lines: Einige Szenen wurden mit KI erstellt.
slots.task: Write your own title and subline.

note: The prompts in prompts/ are worked examples and the source of the reserve clips, not the starting point: the designer briefs each slot from its task.
